title: Dukken i gresset
world: Old rural Norway in early summer, long ago. The king's castle is a large palace of dark logs with grass-covered turf roofs, carved dragon gables and a wide courtyard, among blooming meadows. In a meadow by the road stands the grassy tussock where the tiny maiden lives: a round, knee-high hump of grass and clover that opens like a little door. Inside is a snug, round room with walls of woven roots, a tiny chair, a tiny spinning wheel and a tiny loom. The tiny shirt is snow-white linen with perfect little stitches, no bigger than a man's palm. Her carriage is an ordinary shiny silver tablespoon pulled by two small white mice with reins of red thread. The big lake by the road is wide and still, with reeds and water lilies. Askeladden's horse is a sturdy dun fjord horse with a black-and-cream striped mane.
palette: Early summer: meadows full of buttercups, cornflowers, clover and white daisies, fresh bright-green grass sparkling with dew, and clear morning light under a pale-blue sky with small white clouds. The lake is silver-blue and still. At the castle, a passing summer shower leaves puddles and everything glistening wet.

cast.name: Askeladden
cast.description: Den yngste prinsen, som brødrene ikke vil ha med, men som møter verden med godt hjerte og mot.
cast.look: A tall, gangly young prince of about seventeen with long arms and legs, a long face with deep dimples when he smiles, warm hazel eyes, a straight nose and copper-red hair cut in a round bowl cut. He wears a sky-blue linen smock under a shiny steel breastplate that is a little too big for him, a brown leather belt, loose grey trousers and tall brown riding boots.
cast.portrait: Background: a meadow full of early-summer wildflowers.

cast.name: Dukken i gresset
cast.description: En fin og vennlig jente, først ikke større enn en dukke, som syr en skjorte på én dag og blir like stor som Askeladden etter at hun faller i vannet.
cast.look: A doll-sized young woman of about seventeen, no taller than a doll, slim and light on her feet, with a small heart-shaped face, a tiny upturned nose, sparkling green eyes, rosy cheeks and a bright smile. Her straw-coloured hair hangs in two long pigtails tied with grass-green ribbons, with little daisies and buttercups tucked into it. She wears a simple ankle-length white linen dress with a narrow grass-green sash and tiny green slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: her grassy tussock in a flowering meadow.

cast.name: Dukken i gresset (stor)
cast.description: Dukken i gresset etter at havmannen har hentet henne opp av vannet: nå like stor som Askeladden, og enda finere enn før.
cast.look: A full-sized young woman of about seventeen, slim and graceful, with a small heart-shaped face, a tiny upturned nose, sparkling green eyes, rosy cheeks and a bright smile. Her straw-coloured hair hangs in two long pigtails tied with grass-green ribbons, under a wreath of daisies and buttercups. She wears a finer ankle-length white linen dress embroidered with little green leaves and white flowers along the hem and sleeves, a grass-green sash and green slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: the castle courtyard after a summer shower.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: Faren som setter prøven, men som kjenner igjen flinkhet og godhet når han ser det.
cast.look: A tall, thin, elderly king with narrow, sloping shoulders, a long, lined face, a long pointed nose, shrewd grey eyes under thin arched eyebrows and a neat, pointed grey goatee. He wears a tall, pointed golden crown, a long deep-blue robe with a wide border of rosemaling flowers in red, white and yellow, and pointed dark-blue shoes.

cast.name: Havmannen
cast.description: Et vennlig vesen med fiskehale som bærer Dukken i gresset opp av vannet, forvandlet til full størrelse.
cast.look: A big, friendly merman, a man from the waist up and a fish from the waist down, with a broad, weathered, kind face, a wide flat nose, twinkling sea-green eyes and a gentle smile. His long, wet, dark-green hair hangs to his waist with strands of pondweed in it, and he has a short, curly beard of the same green and a necklace of white river shells. His long tail is covered in shiny silver scales with a blue-green shimmer and ends in a wide, fan-shaped fin.
cast.portrait: Background: the still lake with water lilies.

cover.prompt: A low, close view in a sunny early-summer meadow: the Tiny Grass Maiden stands among buttercups and daisies that tower over her like trees, holding out her skirt in a little curtsy with a bright smile. Right above her, Askeladden lies on his stomach in the grass with his chin on his hands and peers down at her, delighted, his long face dimpled with a big smile. Dew sparkles in the morning light.
cover.caption: Askeladden og Dukken i gresset, som ikke er større enn en dukke.
cover.alt: En bitte liten jente i hvit kjole står blant smørblomster og prestekrager som er høye som trær. Over henne ligger Askeladden på magen i gresset og smiler ned til henne.

illustrations.anchor: «Hei», sa hun og rakte ut hånda.
illustrations.prompt: In a sunny early-summer meadow full of wildflowers, Askeladden sits alone in the grass, hugging his knees, with tears on his cheeks. Right in front of him a round, grassy tussock has opened like a little door, and the Tiny Grass Maiden has stepped out, no bigger than a doll, reaching out her tiny hand to him with a friendly smile. Askeladden stares down at her in surprise. His dun fjord horse grazes nearby. A low, close view at grass level.
illustrations.caption: «Hei», sier jenta fra tua. Hun er ikke større enn en dukke.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden sitter lei seg i gresset. Ut av en tue foran ham har det kommet en bitte liten jente i hvit kjole med blomster i håret, og hun rekker fram hånda.

illustrations.anchor: Hun spant tråden: surr, surr, surr.
illustrations.prompt: Inside the snug, round room under the tussock, with walls of woven grass roots, the Tiny Grass Maiden sits on her tiny chair and sews the last stitches of a tiny white shirt, her tiny spinning wheel and tiny loom beside her. Askeladden has squeezed in and lies on his stomach with his chin in his hands, watching her with wonder; next to him she is as small as a doll. A golden sunset beam slants in through the little door.
illustrations.caption: Surr, surr! Klapp, klapp! Stikk, stikk! Før sola går ned, er skjorta ferdig.
illustrations.alt: Inne i tua sitter den lille jenta på en bitte liten stol og syr en bitte liten skjorte, med en rokk og en vevstol ved siden av seg. Askeladden ligger på magen og ser på.

illustrations.prompt: In the timbered hall of the castle, the King holds the tiny white shirt up between his finger and thumb, right in front of his long nose, and squints at the stitches with one eye shut. Askeladden stands very still in front of him with his hands clasped, cheeks pink with embarrassment, peeking up hopefully. Sunlight falls through a tall window onto the plank floor. A medium view from the side.
illustrations.caption: «Hm, hm», sier kongen og ser på hvert eneste sting.
illustrations.alt: Kongen holder en bitte liten, hvit skjorte mellom to fingre og myser på den med ett øye. Askeladden står helt stille foran ham med hendene foldet.

illustrations.prompt: A wide view of a country road through flowering meadows in bright morning light. On one side of the road Askeladden rides his dun fjord horse at a careful walk, leaning out of the saddle to keep a worried eye on the other side, where the Tiny Grass Maiden drives along in her carriage, a shiny silver spoon pulled by two small white mice, holding the red-thread reins and smiling proudly. Butterflies dance over the buttercups.
illustrations.caption: Klippeti-klopp på den ene siden av veien, tripp-tripp-tripp på den andre.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden rir forsiktig på den ene siden av veien. På den andre siden kjører den lille jenta i en sølvskje som to små, hvite mus drar.

illustrations.anchor: Men hva var dette? Hun var ikke liten lenger!
illustrations.prompt: At the edge of the big, still lake, the Merman has risen waist-deep out of the water among the water lilies, smiling, and holds the Grass Maiden by the hand as she steps onto the shore, no longer tiny but as tall as Askeladden, water drops sparkling on her dress. Askeladden stands on the bank with his mouth open and his arms spread in amazement. The silver spoon lies tipped over in the reeds with the two white mice peeking out from behind it, and the horse waits behind him.
illustrations.caption: Men hva var dette? Hun er ikke liten lenger!
illustrations.alt: En smilende havmann med langt, grønt hår og blank fiskehale holder jenta i hånda ved vannkanten. Hun er blitt like stor som Askeladden, som står på bredden og måper.

illustrations.anchor: «Her skal det bli bryllup!» sa han.
illustrations.prompt: In the castle courtyard just after a summer shower, the King raises his hand high over Askeladden and the Grass Maiden, who stand hand in hand in front of him, two small white mice peeking out of Askeladden's pocket. Along the wall behind them stand the eleven older brothers in their armour in a row, each next to his sweetheart, black streaks running down their noses from their tar-smeared black hats, staring with envy; the eleven sweethearts look sad and bedraggled. Puddles shine on the ground.
illustrations.caption: «Her skal det bli bryllup!» sier kongen.
illustrations.alt: Kongen løfter hånda over Askeladden og jenta i slottsgården. Bak dem står de elleve brødrene med svarte striper nedover nesene sammen med kjærestene sine, og de ser misunnelige ut.
